test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct to Indirect Speech.

He said, "I must reach early."

options.text: He said that he should reach early.
He said that he must reach early,
He said that he will reach early.
He said that he had to reach early.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** He said that he had to reach early.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **“must” becomes “had to” in indirect speech**
